answer: A hollow Sybil defense requires quadratic staking erosion, where each additional identity demands exponentially more collateral, so marginal attack cost scales as n-squared, outpacing linear extracted value from an orchard of colluding nodes; slashing commits liquidity-sink penalties that compound with cluster size, ensuring a sonnet of loss exceeds any feasible reward.
